name: The Seep Mother
place: dungeon mine_descent: floor 2's mini-boss (a 24 m gallery)
_doc: Stream E. A slime that grew in the mine's flooded sump. Two seep pools HEAL her while she sits in them: the tank drags her out. Her caustic spit leaves burning puddles. A swelling bloat lands on the farthest player: someone must stand in it or it bursts over the whole party. At 66% and 33% she sheds a brood of small slimes.
party: Solo: the bloat soak always needs you — doable but you must leave the tank spot. 2-3: intended. 5: easy. M5 scaling: shed adds 2/3 -> 1/2 solo, 3/4 at five.

pull: The sump water heaves itself up into a shape. It has far too many mouths.
Something in the seep has noticed you.
say.death: The Seep Mother slumps into a spreading, harmless puddle.
say.reset: The Seep Mother sinks back into the sump.

soft.say: The air stings. She is getting stronger.

bloat.name: Swelling Bloat
bloat.say: A bloated blister lands near {target} — someone stand in it before it bursts!

telegraphs.failSay: Nobody held the blister — it bursts across the gallery!

ripple.name: Acid Ripple
ripple.say: A ripple runs out from her — step through it close in!

phases.name: Shedding
phases.say: She splits, and the pieces crawl toward you!

phases.name: Boiling
phases.say: The Seep Mother sheds again — she is getting smaller and angrier!
